verdict.rationale: Sardine is an AI-driven fraud and compliance SaaS that processes customer and transaction data, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, data-use restrictions for model training, or any related privacy control. The docs cover KYB/KYC, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and AI agents, but none of that addresses whether customer data trains models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
